t: This is Golders Green Crematorium, the first crematorium to open in London and one of the oldest in Britain. The land was bought in 1900 for six thousand pounds, and Sir Henry Thompson, founder of the Cremation Society, opened it in 1902. The people tied to this place cover a wide range. Sigmund Freud, founder of psychoanalysis, is one. Bram Stoker, author of Dracula, is another. Doris Lessing, Nobel winner and author of The Golden Notebook, is also linked to it. So are the comedian Peter Sellers, best known for Inspector Clouseau, and Enid Blyton, whose books have sold more than 600 million copies.
